scope: Build inputs are separately recorded; they do not become runtime APIs in a deployed bundle.

dependencies.label: Build time Hydration style tokens
dependencies.requiredness: UI workspace build and theme generation fetch the mutable style-token source before generating local theme JSON. The running deployed UI uses bundled generated tokens.

failures.network: Rejected fetch prevents a fresh theme build. No application deadline is supplied for fetch or body parsing.
failures.malformed: HTTP status is not checked before parsing response text as JSON. Invalid JSON or incompatible token shape fails the build/generation step.
failures.stale: Branch URL is mutable and not pinned by yarn.lock. This affects build reproducibility, not the availability of a running bundle.
failures.recovery: Build can be rerun after recovery; the script does not select a local cached source on fetch failure.

existingProtections: Generated theme JSON is bundled for runtime; deployed rendering has no live style-token request.
remediation: Pin or vendor the style-token input and make local generation reproducible independently of public GitHub availability.
dependencies.confidence: Source traced; ordinary workspace build succeeded. No build outage was injected.

evidence.note: fetchTokens downloads style tokens during theme generation.
run awaits tokens before generating local files.
UI build runs yarn theme first.

dependencies.label: Optional asset color generation inputs
endpoints: Icon resources resolved from the asset metadata repository
dependencies.requiredness: Explicit assets:colors generation command, separate from ordinary theme/build. Runtime consumes checked-in assetColors.json and does not generate colors by requesting icons.

failures.network: The manual generation command depends on repository metadata and downloaded image inputs. Fetch has no application deadline.
failures.malformed: JSON/image processing can reject the generation command or individual logo extraction; runtime colors already in the bundle are unaffected.
failures.recovery: Rerun manual generation with working inputs. Runtime does not await this command.

existingProtections: Checked-in generated color map; concurrency cap eight for generation work; fixed color overrides.
remediation: Pin input revisions and bound fetch/body/image work when regenerating colors.
dependencies.confidence: Source traced; no generation outage injected.

evidence.note: Public repository metadata input and generation configuration.
